[i][b]The Humanist Idealist Must Rise to All Human Factions of Erene[/b]

I am Leins Hetrman, hear me to all humans of Erene. Today we celebrate the Humanist Idealist to all International, God indeed gave us the land, the air, the water, and Erene in all for us. As we were descended from Adam and Eve. God is giving our dam rights over all Erene.  But the Non-Human Kind rose from hell, came with a mission to destroy all humankind, men, women, and children, and they threaten to get rid of us. But we rise in the goal of uniting all humans as one. And fought a holy war to wipe out all non-humans. Nowadays, people of humankind change; they befriend these beasts who try to get rid of us in the beginning. Cant you see, that's their plan to secretly befriend us, we have the number, we have the power, and we dominate this planet, 80% of the total population! Rather than leading to the extinction of our species, we should start back and finish what we have done! We should rise for all humans, white, yellow, black, etc, to unite as a whole. We should finish them, cant you see that they are controlling our government, our job, and our will to be a free human! We cant watch our sister and brother die out there fighting on the frontline, this is what the non-human species wanted! Destruction! Pain! And lost! So they can rise and get rid of all humans! Furries are the main species to inhabit the Non-Human race. They are at fault for causing war, corruption, and death to the Human race. And you know who's helping them to achieve their goal, ULR AND NEW WESTMORE! They are those who have backstabbed their kind for helping these beasts!  They even ally to go against their people; they are corrupted by Non-Human. The Oceanic Republic stands alone in this fight for all humans to see! So I say we dissolve the AI pact for once and form the Human Pact or UN to stand and advocate for all humankind. [/i]
